sentences.en: The treaty has been concluded after many twists and turns.
sentences.zh: 该条约在许多曲折之后终于缔结。

sentences.en: A radical disarmament treaty prohibits all armaments and armed forces.
sentences.zh: 一项激进的裁军条约禁止所有武器和武装部队。

sentences.en: A treaty is, as it were, a contract between countries.
sentences.zh: 条约可以说是国家之间的合同。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：treat（处理）+y→处理（纷争的文件）→条约
